description: This is the $2 Billion E-commerce Funnel We Use to Scale Some of Your Favorite Brands 🤑
transcript: This is the two billion dollar e commerce funnel we use to scale some of your favorite brands. And it is not just run more ads. That is what most brands get wrong today. The funnel starts with attention. We build creative around the actual reason people buy. The problem they feel, the result that they want, the rejection stopping them. Then we turn that into meta ads, TikTok Shop, content creator videos, statics, UGC founder ads, and offer driven creatives. That is step one. Create demand. Step two is conversion. Because traffic means nothing if the website leaks. So we rebuild the product page like a sales page with a stronger hook. A clear offer, reviews guarantees, comparison charts, objection handling and sticky add to carts, subscription options, upsells. Everything is built to increase conversion rate in AOV. Step 3 is distribution. This is where TikTok Shop comes in. Creators become the sales force. Affiliates post the product lives create urgency. And GMV Max scales the winners. The best organic content today gets moved into paid ads. Now the brand is not just relying on one ad account. It has creators pushing the product every single day. And step four is retention. Email and SMS bring people back. Post purchase flows, replenishment, cross sells subscriptions, wind back flows, VIP offers. This is where LTV gets built. And this is the whole system. Meta creates demand. TikTok Shop distributes that demand. Google and Amazon capture demand. The website converts the Demand an email and SMS. Monetize demand and keep it going. Most brands are trying to scale one channel. We build the full system, create a volume conversion rates, AOVS, LTV's distribution. That is the funnel behind two billion dollar e commerce brands growing right now. Comment funnel and I'll send you the full breakdown.
